name: Verified → roll up the delivery coherence gate (check_coherence)
description:
The coherence gate station (design D16, group 8D). After the clean-room cold verify has recorded a terminal verify.result, roll up the three independent delivery signals — verify.result (the cold proof), openspec.validated (the OpenSpec oracle), and EVERY projected task's review.verdict — and derive coherent (open the PR) or blocked (park toward the human). This is a TOOL, not rule conditions, for the same three reasons check_gate is: a loop-fired rule cannot read RUN facts, the review roll-up counts projected tasks vs approved verdicts (not a length_* on one predicate), and a wildcard field-to-field compare floods #519 — all force the roll-up into Go. G3: check_coherence takes no arguments; the decision is harness-derived, fail-closed (a non-pass/absent signal blocks — SB5 never encodes 'couldn't prove' as a pass).

TRIGGER = the VERIFY loop terminal, chained on the dev.verified loop marker (warn-free). verify_artifact stamps dev.verified on ITS OWN verify loop ONLY for a TERMINAL verdict (pass/fail) — a retry re-runs the proof rather than stamping the marker, so a transient docker flake never chains a retry into this gate (which would block a good run). This rule fires on agent.loop.role=coordinator (the verify loop is a coordinator loop) AND dev.verified ne "". The pair distinguishes the verify loop from the other coordinator loops (provision/measure/floors/gate) — none carry dev.verified.

RUN BINDING: run_scope=inherit binds the check_coherence loop to the verify loop's agent.run, so check_coherence reads THIS run's verify.result + openspec.validated + task.spec + review.verdict and stamps pr.coherence.* on the run.

ROLE = coordinator (Sarah owns the harness tools). tool_choice=function forces check_coherence; the loop calls it and StopLoops, writing pr.coherence.* + the dev.coherence_decided loop marker.

SELF-EXTINGUISHING ONE-SHOT (restart-safe): on_enter FIRST stamps dev.coherence_dispatched=$entity.instance on the verify loop, guarded by dev.coherence_dispatched length_eq 0. House restart-safety pattern (dev-from-task/04..10): publish_agent is NOT idempotent and dev.verified stays stamped, so WITHOUT this marker a graph replay would re-spawn a duplicate coherence loop. Marker stamped BEFORE the publish. LOOP-scoped (fires on the verify loop). A fresh verify loop per attempt re-arms the gate for free.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt: SEMDEV — the committed artifact was verified in the clean room. Now roll up the delivery coherence gate: call check_coherence. The harness reads the clean-room verify result, the OpenSpec validation, and every task's review verdict and derives coherent (open the PR) or blocked (park toward the human) — you supply nothing and claim no outcome. Calling check_coherence completes your turn.

metadata.station: check_coherence — roll up the delivery gate on the verify-loop terminal (D16, 8D)
metadata.trigger_rationale: fires on the VERIFY loop terminal via the dev.verified loop marker (verify_artifact stamps it only for a terminal pass/fail; a retry re-runs). role=coordinator + dev.verified distinguishes the verify loop. Loop-marker chaining, #519-immune.
metadata.role_rationale: coordinator (Sarah's harness tool). tool_choice=function:check_coherence + nil tools forces the call.
metadata.restart_safe: SELF-EXTINGUISHING via the LOOP-scoped dev.coherence_dispatched marker + length_eq 0 guard. Marker stamped BEFORE the publish. check_coherence's StopLoop keeps the loop one turn.
metadata.g3: check_coherence takes no arguments; it rolls up harness-stamped signals and derives coherent/blocked in Go, fail-closed, never a model claim.
metadata.chain_note: the two delivery routers (dev-from-task/12a/b) fire on the check_coherence LOOP's dev.coherence_decided marker: coherent → open_pr (pr.ref), blocked → run.awaiting_human park (the fourth park realization). See design.md group-8 section.
